I was unable to connect to Chrome. The browser connection failed because Chrome is not running with remote debugging enabled. The DevToolsActivePort file was not found at `/Users/ravi/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome/DevToolsActivePort`.

To fix this, the user needs to:
1. Open Chrome with remote debugging enabled. This can be done by launching Chrome from the terminal with:
   ```
   /Applications/Google\ Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google\ Chrome --remote-debugging-port=9222
   ```
2. Or navigate to `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging` in an already-running Chrome instance and ensure remote debugging is enabled.

Once Chrome is running with remote debugging, I can retry opening `http://localhost:5173/` and take a screenshot.
